question: Will the Fenmoor Regional Wastewater Plant's standby generator still have fuel in its day tank when grid power is restored at 12:00 noon on Tuesday 22 September 2026?
resolution_note: YES only if the generator's day tank still holds fuel at the deadline and the generator has not stopped for want of fuel at any point between 6:00 AM and 12:00 noon on 22 September 2026. Running dry at any time in that window counts as no.
